scope: A5 MQSMLA source/private dependencies; D448 RoPE0 internal-padding proposal; original RoPE64 retained.
adaptations: Relative includes target private frozen dependencies.
Host checker namespace and helper names isolated from existing SparseFlashMla.
Private checker CMake registration names avoid target-level de-duplication collisions.
AICPU CMake uses vllm-ascend three-argument helper.
Removed an unused op_host/tiling_util.h include: no MQSMLA code uses its declarations, and it depends on an otherwise unnecessary opbase source header unavailable in the installed SDK.
Metadata build compatibility: include metadata_check.h second in ACLNN source and opdev/op_log.h after log/log.h in metadata checker; preserved from migrated baseline.

Metadata packaging: enable ENABLE_AICPU in the production branch after registering the AICPU object target so the selected operator-pair build links and packages its CPU kernel; preserved without modifying op_kernel_aicpu/CMakeLists.txt.
RoPE0 contract: external Q/output448, quant_mode1 KV480B, quant_mode2 PA KV456B; internal Q/K/V and FD remain512 with initialized zero RoPE64 placeholders.
RoPE0 KV copies use per-token normalization to the original608B UB record; raw scales and physical PA feature/scale offsets are retained.
Original RoPE64 compute/copy branches retained; new RoPE0 quant_mode2 accepts only the documented PA_BBND layout.
